answer_1.quote: Despite the recent advances in machine translation (MT), translation memories (TM) play a prominent role ... In this paper, we present an approach aimed at overcoming the aforementioned limitation by enabling the exploitation of in-domain TL monolingual corpora in CAT tools and increase the chance of getting useful translation proposals.
answer_1.outputs: translation proposals (target‑language sentences retrieved or generated for a source sentence)

answer_2.quote: We computed the translation edit rate (TER; ) between every translation proposal t and its corresponding reference translation, t , and considered useful those proposals with a TER below 0.4.

answer_4.quote: A human evaluation on one of the language pairs, in which professional translators were asked to assess the usefulness of the translation proposals obtained with FMS and neuroMatch ... Six professional translators were provided EN‑ES ... they were asked to indicate which translation proposals they would use as a draft translation to be post‑edited, or if they would rather translate the source sentence from scratch.
answer_4.guideline: Translators indicated whether they would use a proposal as a draft for post‑editing or translate from scratch, and if both proposals were acceptable they chose the one requiring less post‑editing effort.
